name: Bodil
title: Charter Feller-boss
examine: A Pinewatch sawyer's daughter running six fellers on a licence with a lot number. Cuts up to the thread and has started past it. Somebody leaves knucklebones on her rope.
lines: Up to the thread is the licence. Past the thread is dying anyway. I cut what will burn and I do not charge the wood for its opinions.
They had words. They used the other ones. He was thirty feet in and he did not know he was being warned. That is all I have to say about the old folk.
Somebody leaves a knucklebone on my rope for every snag they take. It is a tidy thief, at least. I have never had a tidy thief before.
